truncated.description: `text` was cut at the page-text bound; present only when true.

oneOf.description:
Result of a boundary submit that used `networkQuiet` or no expected
state as its postcondition. This classifies the settled page without
requiring the caller to predict confirmation copy or risk a second submit.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of each uploaded file's content, in `paths` order.

oneOf.description: Retained page-context generation after command bookkeeping.

A popup closed during creation, or a handle's popup has since closed.
The opener remains the handle's target. A subsequent read-only retry
can carry this evidence on completion. A subsequent mutation that hits a
closed popup carries it on failure.

savedTo.description:
The exact caller-supplied destination after it passed the configured
downloads-root policy. Absolute input is echoed as absolute; relative
input remains relative. The runtime never discovers or exposes a path
the caller did not already provide.

observed.description:
What the satisfying poll actually read: the element text or value,
the URL, or the document ready state, depending on the condition.

Bounded by [`MAX_WAIT_OBSERVED_CHARS`]: a verification value, never
a page-text dump.

oneOf.description:
The session, workflow and page a screenshot was taken in, the page's
address and when it was taken.

The one-time-code step the page is showing: where the code goes, how
long it is when the page says, and the page's own words about where it
was sent. Page-derived.

A challenge classification from `detectChallenge`: `Some` is a
detected challenge, `None` is a provably clean page. `confidence` is
the model's confidence in its answer either way — a caller gating a
solve spend on a clean answer needs it. `prior_kind` records the site
prior that enriched the prompt when one existed — transparency, never
a blended answer.

The vision model's reading of the page after a landed submit.
`message` is page-derived text the model quoted.

Input timing the runtime synthesized rather than observed, emitted when
the session opted into `executionPolicy.humanize`. Lets `intent-engine`
verify an effect against the timing actually issued. Carries no typed
text: action counts and durations only.

Result of resolving one named field of an `ExtractIntent`, emitted once
per field in field order. `value: None` means unresolved, with the
reason in `errorCode`; the rest of the extraction still runs.

ExecutionPath.description:
Which strategy served a command: the direct-HTTP reader, or the live
browser. The browser variants name the *strategy*, never an engine — a
Firefox-companion run reports `browser`, and reporting `chromium` there
contradicted the `browserExecution` evidence sitting beside it. The old
wire names still deserialize so recorded journals keep replaying.

oneOf.description:
The page has mutated since load (a non-read-only command ran against
it), so a whole-page read must come from the live DOM, not a refetch.

AccessibilityNode.description: One node in an `accessibilitySnapshot` result tree.

inputType.description: Normalized native input type, used to distinguish file controls from buttons.

url.description:
Link destination, when the engine reports one for this node. Lets an
agent feed `download_url` (or navigate) without an HTML round-trip.

AccessibilityTarget.description: Semantic target for accessibility-based commands (role + accessible name).

framePath.description:
Frame hops from the main frame to the document holding this node;
empty for main-frame nodes. Segments are the same role/name/ordinal
shape `FormControlTarget.frame_path` resolves, so the target can be
passed verbatim to `control_action`.

FormSnapshot.description: Semantic form observation returned by form-snapshot endpoints and evidence.

label.description:
Only serialized when it differs from `accessibleName` — the builder
collapses the label onto the accessible name at snapshot time, so a
fresh empty form costs ~200 bytes per control instead of ~740.

names.description:
Names of the files the control holds or, holding none, its widget
shows.

willValidate.description:
Always serialized: a bool whose default is `true` cannot use
`serde(default)` + skip (absent would decode to `false`, flipping the
meaning on round-trip). `false` is rare but load-bearing.

FormValidationIssue.description:
Compact, value-free repair evidence for a control that rejected a form
submission. Carries the semantic target and browser validity without the
rest of the form snapshot.

revealedControls.description:
Controls that appeared because of this action (conditional fields,
e.g. a billing-cycle select revealed by a plan choice). Read this
before re-snapshotting: the targets are passable to `control_action`
verbatim.

RevealedControl.description:
A form control that an action revealed (conditional field). Emitted on
`ControlActionEvidence` so an agent learns about fields that did not
exist at snapshot time without re-snapshotting the whole page.

oneOf.description: A Turnstile "verify you are human" widget.

PageOutcome.description: What the page showed after a landed submit, as the vision model read it.

oneOf.description: An error, rejection or validation message.

CookieRecord.description: One cookie as returned by a cookie read on any engine.

oneOf.description: Resolved from a cached proactive vision proposal.

Resolved from a label a verified vision answer stored on an earlier
visit, without a vision call.
